[SWS_DM_01114] Data storage for event combination on retrieval
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04200, RS_Diag_04067
⌈
If
DiagnosticCommonProps.typeOfEventCombinationSupported
is set to
eventCombinationOnRetrieval
, the DM shall trigger the collection, update and
storage of event related data per event.
⌋
